findings: Scheduler update_from_output builds speculation counts for each executed step and includes them in EngineCoreOutputs.scheduler_stats.
AsyncLLM.output_handler processes each EngineCoreOutputs then synchronously calls logger_manager.record; PrometheusStatLogger.record directly calls SpecDecodingProm.observe.
SpecDecodingProm.observe immediately increments cumulative round, proposed token, accepted token and accepted-position counters. This does not wait for periodic console log output.

OutputProcessor queue.put is nonblocking. In the qualified C1 run, one output chunk and no stop-string abort produce no await between queued request completion and synchronous counter recording. The completed HTTP stream is therefore observed after these counters are recorded.

Warmup is drained before the before snapshot, and the complete measured request set is drained before the after snapshot. The Pro production delta is 34944 rounds,209664 proposed drafts,96000 accepted drafts for128requests.

Counters include accepted proposals on the final round before client output clipping; they are not exact committed client tokens. Conditional position rates use accepted[j]/accepted[j-1], with rounds as position0 denominator.

scope.qualified_current_window: Pro aggregated C1,ignore_eos=true,no stop strings,single API process
scope.future_scope_note: For multiple API processes, abort paths, or chunked output handling that yields between chunks, audit event ordering and drain all endpoints before interpreting window deltas. P/D acceptance uses decode endpoint only.
